answer: Because the ocean beacon is unpredictable until close, the delta panel cannot be arranged, and the violet audit records the draw inputs for every case. The 5 jurors for each case are drawn by lottery from the established pool using the epoch beacon, and the draw is published only after submissions close. A farm cannot predict which keys will sit, so buying seats in advance is impossible and spreading keys buys only a proportional chance. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
